# Cosmic Nidhi - Vedic Astrology & Vastu Consultation
> Authentic Vedic astrology, personalized birth chart readings, applied Vastu consultations, and certified spiritual gemstones.

## Overview
Cosmic Nidhi is a premier platform dedicated to authentic Vedic wisdom, personalized astrological analysis, and spatial energy alignment. Founded with over 10+ years of dedicated practice and thousands of charts analyzed, Cosmic Nidhi bridges classical knowledge with practical modern guidance.

## Core Offerings & Services
- **Birth Chart / Janam Kundli Reading**: In-depth analysis of planetary positions, Dasha periods, career, marriage, health, and spiritual alignment.
- **Applied Vastu Consultation**: Spatial energy analysis, zone balancing, home/office gridding, and non-destructive Vastu remedies.
- **Numerology Consultations**: Life path number, destiny number, personal year cycles, and relationship compatibility analysis.
- **Kundli Matching & Relationship Guidance**: Comprehensive Guna Milan (Ashtakoota), planetary compatibility, and contextual guidance.
- **Pitra Dosh Analysis**: Vedic horoscope analysis to identify ancestral imbalances and recommended Vedic remedies.
- **Certified Gemstones & Spiritual Jewelry**: Natural, lab-certified gemstone bracelets, rudraksha, and sacred crystals.
